description: Long graphs (fit-everything zoom < SCROLL_MODE_FIT_ZOOM 0.3) open at READABLE_MIN_ZOOM (0.65, tune by screenshots) positioned at the graph start (rank axis start-aligned; cross axis start-aligned only if the user card fits, else centered on the user, because the user sits at the lane midpoint) inside the overlay-free region, using pure planFit/readableViewport math extending fitPadding.ts (incl. scroll-axis-aware strip assignment), applied via setViewport; graphs that fit at >= 0.3 keep today's overlay-aware fitView untouched. Adds a muted role=status scroll hint pill (top-center, pointer-events none, fit-ignored) shown only in drill-down when the long path was chosen and content is out of view. Revises the overlay invariant for long graphs. Depends on FEAT-001 only through the shared AccessGraphCanvas.tsx (goes second). Includes the real-browser Z1/Z2 runs, an H1 regression pass, cleanup and the final report.
steps: Read plan.md (D3, D4, D5, D6, D7, steps 4-7, 11-12, revised invariant, Z1/Z2 protocol), context.json and FEAT-001's findings first.
Check the real signature of getViewportForBounds/getNodesBounds in node_modules/@xyflow/system before using them.

Extend src/graph/fitPadding.ts: constants READABLE_MIN_ZOOM (0.65) and SCROLL_MODE_FIT_ZOOM (0.3); FitPaddingOptions.scrollAxis ('x'|'y') + scrollAxisPenalty (default 3) affecting only the side choice in computeFitPadding (no scrollAxis = identical behavior); exported pure planFit(...) returning {mode:'fit',padding} or {mode:'readable',viewport,padding,overflows}; exported pure readableViewport with per-axis rule (content fits -> center; else start-align if the focus box fits in the aligned window, else center the focus box); exported pure isGraphOutOfView(bounds, transform, canvas, tolerance); measureOverlays skips `.vc-graph-fit-ignore`; update the top doc comment with the revised invariant (Mode A strict, Mode B long-graph rules).

Extend src/graph/fitPadding.test.ts with the pure tests listed in plan.md (unchanged behavior without scrollAxis, scroll-axis side choice using representative panel rects from the layout-fixes screenshots, planFit fit vs readable incl. boundary and TB, viewport math cases, isGraphOutOfView, measureOverlays ignoring the hint panel via per-instance rect stubs).

In src/graph/AccessGraphCanvas.tsx extend FitOnSceneChange with props rankdir, inDrilldown, onPlan({fitKey,long}); keep deps [fitKey,width,height,fitView,store]; read getNodes() inside the rAF; in drill-down call planFit with minZoom 0.15, maxZoom 1.8, scrollAxis (LR 'y', TB 'x'); mode fit -> existing fitView({padding}) path; readable -> setViewport(viewport,{duration:0}) from useReactFlow; grid path unchanged. Keep refit triggers exactly as today; do not change Controls or minZoom. Update the doc comments (revised invariant, D3/D4/D5).

{n} items — scroll or drag to see all

; visible only when plan state matches the current fitKey and long, and a boolean useStore selector using isGraphOutOfView(getNodesBounds(s.nodes), s.transform, {width:s.width,height:s.height})). Render only when inDrilldown && !isDegenerate, with itemCount = first-level scene nodes. Add CSS (.vc-graph-hint like .vc-graph-note; panel pointer-events none; same top offset/height as the Back button) in src/graph/AccessGraph.css.

Per-instance rect stubs only; grep new tests for Element.prototype/HTMLElement.prototype.

Run Z1 (dense) and Z2 (standard) over fixture x {1700x1000, 1000x700} x shown/hidden x LR/TB x minimap on/off exactly as specified in plan.md: zoom == READABLE_MIN_ZOOM, label >= ~10 px effective, user + 3 nearest items fully visible clear of overlays, hint present/placed/role, wheel (TB: shift/deltaX) reaches the LAST and FIRST item clear of overlays, drag pans, Controls fit-view shows the whole graph at zoom >= 0.15 and hides the hint, ctrl-wheel zoom out bottoms at 0.15, refit triggers and resize round trip, Z2 zooms equal the baseline table and old strict invariant holds. acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/graph` passes, including new pure planFit/readableViewport/isGraphOutOfView tests and RTL zoom tests; existing fit tests still pass.

In real Chrome, dense graphs (both reference modes, both directions, both viewports) open at zoom within 0.005 of READABLE_MIN_ZOOM with the user card and its 3 nearest lane items fully visible and clear of every overlay, and wheel scrolling reaches the first and last item fully inside the canvas clear of overlays.

In real Chrome the standard (short) graph fits exactly as before: zooms equal the baseline table within 0.01 and the old strict invariant (no node under an overlay, all nodes in canvas) holds; no hint appears.

The scroll hint is role=status, shows '25 items — scroll or drag to see all' only for long drill-down graphs, never overlaps toolbar/Back/legend/minimap/Controls, and disappears after the Controls fit-view button shows everything (all nodes in canvas, zoom >= 0.15).
minZoom stays 0.15, refit triggers unchanged, hover/focus emphasis from FEAT-001 still works on dense graphs at readable zoom.

Constants: READABLE_MIN_ZOOM 0.65, SCROLL_MODE_FIT_ZOOM 0.3 (both kept after screenshots), scrollAxisPenalty default 2 (plan said 3; 3 pushed more overlays into the rank axis at 1000x700 shown, 2 and 1.5 behaved the same). planFit also returns the normal fit for an unmeasured 0x0 canvas. Hint (ScrollHint.tsx) included.
